relations.subject: Agehananda Bharati
relations.evidence: Swami Agehananda Bharati (Sanskrit: अगेहानन्द भारती, romanized: Svamī Agehānanda Bhāratī; Vienna, April 20, 1923 – New York, May 14, 1991) was a professor of anthropology at Syracuse University
